name: dineOS Order Triage (webhook to LLM to Slack)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: ($env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL || 'claude-sonnet-4-5'), max_tokens: 400, system: 'You are an operations assistant for the dineOS restaurant platform. Given a JSON order event, reply with ONE concise sentence that summarizes the order (table/customer, item count, total) and explicitly flags whether it needs staff attention (high value, many items, or allergy / special-request notes). Plain text only, no preamble.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: ('Order event JSON:\n' + JSON.stringify($json.body || $json)) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: (':bell: *dineOS order triage*\n' + ((($json.content && $json.content[0] && $json.content[0].text)) || 'AI summary unavailable - set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable LLM triage.')) }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, summary: ((($('Anthropic Triage').item.json.content && $('Anthropic Triage').item.json.content[0] && $('Anthropic Triage').item.json.content[0].text)) || 'AI summary unavailable - set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable LLM triage.') } }}

meta.description: M5.8 automation pipeline. A POST to /webhook/order-triage triggers an Anthropic LLM call that summarizes and flags the order, posts the result to Slack, and returns the summary in the HTTP response. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL and SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL from the n8n container environment.
